subject: Security checkpoints and pen test request — Swan Holdings onboarding
body:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@swanhq.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@swanholdings.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 16:15:00 +0000
Subject: Security checkpoints and pen test request — Swan Holdings onboarding

Hi Amanda / Oliver,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to meet the Swan security and product leads. Per our discovery, I wanted to summarize the security/compliance items we agreed to follow up on and capture next steps so we can keep the onboarding timeline moving: 

- SOC 2: please confirm whether you have a current SOC 2 Type II report and the date range covered. If available, can you share the report or a bridge letter?
- Data protection: confirm GDPR controller/processor responsibilities and whether HIPAA applies to the workload we discussed (healthcare metadata ingestion).
- Vendor security questionnaire: I’m attaching our standard vendor questionnaire (vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx) — if you can start the form and return the checklist it will speed the intake.
- Pen test report: we requested the most recent external penetration test report. If you can share, that’s ideal; otherwise, we’ll need a statement of scope and remediation history.
- Vulnerability management: please confirm your SLA expectations for critical/high findings and any blackout windows for remediation. We typically propose 30 days for Critical, 90 days for High, and a quarterly scanning cadence unless otherwise agreed.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Amanda to upload SOC 2 summary and any existing pen-test artifacts by end of week (Fri, Nov 6).
2) Swan fills vendor questionnaire and returns to security@redwood.com.
3) Evelyn to send the pen-test intake form and clarify our vulnerability disclosure expectations + remediation SLA.
4) Marcus/LAuren schedule a 30‑minute follow-up next week to confirm procurement checklist and any contract redlines.

I’ve attached the questionnaire for convenience and a short pen-test intake template (redwood-pen-test-request-form.pdf). Happy to call through any item — propose Wed 11/5 09:00 UTC if that works for you.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---

From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@swanhq.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@swanholdings.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 17:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security checkpoints and pen test request — Swan Holdings onboarding

Thanks Marcus — great summary. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report for FY2025 (period Apr 2025–Mar 2026). We can share a redacted copy with an NDA.
- HIPAA: the workload is partially regulated — we process pseudonymized health metadata for analytics; full PHI is not in scope today, but we need to ensure any future PHI pipelines are covered.
- Pen test: our last external pentest was done June 2026 and the vendor provided a summary (high-level) but the full report is covered by our engagement NDA with the testing firm. We can share a summary PDF (swan-previous-pen-test-summary.pdf) and discuss sharing the full report under mutual NDA.
- SLA expectations: we can commit to 30 days for Critical and 60 days for High, but for some high-risk remediation (platform-level), we may need a phased plan with dates.

We’ll start filling the questionnaire and aim to upload SOC2 artifacts under the HubSpot ticket by EOD Friday. I also want to understand Redwood’s vulnerability disclosure policy and whether you run periodic authenticated scans (app + infra).

Amanda Li
Head of Security Operations | Swan Holdings
amanda.li@swanhq.com

---

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@swanhq.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@swanholdings.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security checkpoints and pen test request — Swan Holdings onboarding

Hi Amanda — thanks for the quick reply and the context. A few clarifications from Redwood security / vendor onboarding perspective: 

- Sharing documents: we can accept a redacted SOC 2 Type II or a bridge letter initially. For the full pen test report we require a signed mutual NDA before exchanging vendor-contracted reports; the summary PDF you mentioned is fine to start.
- Pen test scope: for our compliance intake we ask that external pentests cover internet-exposed services that will be used in the Redwood integration (API endpoints, auth flows, and any data ingestion pipelines). If June 2026 covered that scope, the summary will help; if not, we will request a scoped test for those endpoints.
- Vulnerability SLA: our default remediation targets (for mutual action plan purposes) are: Critical = 30 days, High = 90 days, Medium = 180 days. However, we can accept Swan’s proposed 60 days for High if you provide a remediation plan with milestones for platform-level issues. Any exceptions should be documented in the MAP.
- Scanning cadence: quarterly authenticated scans + continuous external monitoring is preferred. We can accept vendor-supplied scan artifacts (DAST/SAST/IAST) if they include remediation ticket references.
- Coordinated disclosure: Redwood supports coordinated disclosure and will provide an initial triage within 48 hours of report receipt. We do not publicly disclose vulnerabilities until fix or coordinated publication is agreed. We ask vendors to maintain a public contact or security@ address for reporting.

I’m attaching our pen-test intake template (redwood-pen-test-request-form.pdf) and the vendor questionnaire (vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx) in the HubSpot ticket. For the NDA flow — Marcus, can you share the standard Redwood mutual NDA link with Swan? Lauren, looping you for legal/contract alignment.

Evelyn Hart
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com

---

From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@swanhq.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@swanholdings.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security checkpoints and pen test request — Swan Holdings onboarding

Appreciate the detail, Evelyn. We’ll: 
- Upload the redacted SOC 2 and the pen-test summary PDF to the HubSpot ticket by Friday (ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890).
- Start the vendor questionnaire today and aim to return it by Tue 11/10.
- We agree to the 30-day Critical SLA; for High we will provide a phased remediation plan and accept a 60–90 day window depending on scope.
- We’ll sign a mutual NDA and then share the full pen-test artifacts with Redwood security.

Marcus — Wed 11/5 09:00 UTC works for a short follow-up. Please send a calendar invite. Also confirming PO and procurement contacts will be included on the follow-up if needed.

Thanks,

Amanda

Attachments referenced: vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx; redwood-pen-test-request-form.pdf; swan-previous-pen-test-summary.pdf
